overall_goal: Prepare dough balls, place them on trays, and add meat topping to them.

goals.description: Portion, knead, roll, and place the first three dough balls onto the tray.
goals.rationale: The person cuts, kneads, and rolls the first few pieces of dough, placing them onto the first tray.

goals.description: Portion, knead, roll, and place the next two dough balls onto the tray.
goals.rationale: The person continues to cut, oil, knead, and roll more dough, adding the resulting balls to the tray and adjusting their spacing.

goals.description: Portion, knead, roll, and place two more dough balls onto the first tray.
goals.rationale: The person finishes filling the first tray by preparing and placing the final dough balls for it.

goals.description: Portion, knead, roll, and place the first few dough balls onto the second tray.
goals.rationale: The person starts placing newly formed dough balls onto a second tray, repeating the cutting, rolling, and shaping process.

goals.description: Portion, knead, roll, and place the final three dough balls onto the second tray.
goals.rationale: The person finishes the remaining dough in the bowl, shaping the last few balls and placing them on the second tray.

goals.description: Discard the empty dough bowl into the sink and wash and dry hands.
goals.rationale: The person cleans up by putting the empty bowl in the sink and washing the sticky dough off their hands.

goals.description: Retrieve the meat topping and add it to the first three dough balls.
goals.rationale: The person grabs the pan of meat topping and begins pressing portions of meat into the centers of the first few dough balls.

goals.description: Continue adding meat topping to the remaining dough balls on the tray.
goals.rationale: The person repeats the process of pinching meat from the pan and pressing it into the centers of the rest of the dough balls.
